settings.heading: Made slowly, on purpose.
settings.text: Karakoram Naturals began with one family recipe and one stubborn idea: if we wouldn't feed it to our own children, we won't sell it.

settings.heading: It started in our grandmother's kitchen.
settings.text:
Every morning the madhani turned in the clay matka, and every week there was fresh ghee on the table. We still make it exactly that way — just a few more jars at a time.

Replace this text with the real Karakoram Naturals story: who you are, where your farm is, and why you started.

settings.title: Grass-fed milk
settings.text: Fresh whole milk from free-grazing cows, milked at dawn.

settings.title: Set overnight
settings.text: Boiled, cooled and set into curd in clay matkas.

settings.title: Hand-churned
settings.text: The curd is churned with a wooden madhani until makhan rises.

settings.title: Makhan
settings.text: White butter is lifted, washed and gathered — nothing else goes in.

settings.title: Slow-cooked
settings.text: Simmered over a low wood fire until golden and danedar.

settings.title: Jarred warm
settings.text: Filtered, jarred warm and sealed. Batch number on every lid.

settings.title: Nothing added
settings.text: No colours, oils, fillers or preservatives. Ever.

settings.title: Tested, every batch
settings.text: Independent lab reports, published for everyone to see.

settings.title: Made by hand
settings.text: Small batches, made by people — not by a factory line.
